text:
alex: noticed a reconnect spike post-canary at 08:12. reconnects ~0.9% vs normal ~0.03%.

alex: logs show: 
```
streamer-12 ERROR state-serialize id=tenant-42 sess=abcd1234 checksum=0x9f->0x7c
streamer-12 WARN parse header mismatch proto=v2 expected=v1
```

maria: sounds like the new compact header change. @jing which PR was that?

jing: PR #1123 removed legacy version byte to save space. tested on canary with synthetic load but not against old proxies that may replay sessions.

samir: console only shows overall reconnect rate. can we tag reconnects by session protocol and route? need to see if particular routes/proxies are impacted.

alex: agree. quick mitigation: runtime should accept both header variants (v2 primary, fallback v1) and emit metric `stream.session.proto` with `v1`/`v2`. i'll take rollback decision if needed.

jing: i'll push hotfix for tolerant parsing + metric. small change.

maria: i'll add dashboard tiles: "Reconnects by sess_proto" and heatmap by route_id. also add a rollout note to require emitting `sess_proto` for protocol changes.

samir: add alerting: tenant-level reconnect >0.2% over 5m with >100 sessions pages oncall. otherwise post only to #eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: canary rollout: streamer-runtime-v2 -> canary-cluster-1 (10%) at 08:12 by jing.

alert-bot: alert fired streaming-reconnects-high at 08:26 global 0.92% (5m).

jing: hotfix deployed to canary: try v2 parse, fallback v1, increment `stream.session.proto`.

alex: add obfuscated `route_id` and `proxy_id` to logs for mapping to routing policy. sample query: 
```bash
kubectl logs -l app=streamer -n prod --since=15m | grep "state-serialize" | head -n 30
```

maria: dashboard updated. small UX banner on rollout page reminding to add telemetry on protocol changes. tile link in the rollout ticket. :thumbsup:

samir: scheduling targeted validation: replay 5k sessions through legacy proxies on canary to confirm no checksum mismatch.

alex: plan: 1) jing hotfix; 2) maria dashboard + alert; 3) samir validation; 4) promote to 50% if reconnect <0.2% for 30m, otherwise rollback. rollback threshold >0.5% reconnect.

jing: hotfix rolling on canary now. will post status.

deploy-bot: rollout update: streamer-runtime-v2-hotfix -> canary-cluster-1 (rolling) at 08:41.

alert-bot: resolved streaming-reconnects-high at 09:05 global 0.08% (5m).

alex: postmortem todo: add a test for proxy replay with both header variants, require `sess_proto` emission for protocol changes, and document the compact header in the migration guide.

samir: validation job queued; will report results.

jing: follow-up PR opened with tests + migration notes: https://git/redwood/streamer/pull/1138

alex: thanks all, closing thread.
